question: In herpes simplex encephalitis, drugs used are, EXCEPT:
analysis: In the treatment of herpes simplex encephalitis, the drug of choice is acyclovir due to its efficacy in treating herpes viruses. Vidarabine is an antiviral medication but is not commonly used for herpes simplex encephalitis. Ganciclovir is another antiviral drug used for different types of herpes viruses, but it is not typically used for herpes simplex encephalitis. Amantadine is not an antiviral drug and is not indicated for the treatment of herpes simplex encephalitis.
